items.title: Nvidia earnings, PCE data: What investors need to watch Wednesday
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews the stories that'll be making headlines on Wednesday, August 25th, including Nvidia's (NVDA) highly anticipated earnings after the close, results from Salesforce (CRM) and CrowdStrike (CRWD), and a fresh read on inflation with the latest Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) data hitting before the bell.

items.title: AI Monetization Boosts ADBE's Growth Prospects Against MSFT & CRM
items.summary: Adobe's AI-first ARR more than tripled to above $500M as Firefly, Acrobat AI and enterprise tools expand monetization across subscriptions and usage.

items.title: Meta, Nvidia, Intuit, Salesforce, Moderna, Abercrombie, Zoom, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Meta Platforms agrees to pay $18 billion to settle a lawsuit over its social media practices, and Nvidia earnings are scheduled for after the closing bell Wednesday.

items.title: Software Stocks Face an AI Reckoning, SAP Downgrade Is the Latest Blow
items.summary: The software sector’s artificial-intelligence pain is starting to look chronic.  Intuit Zoom Communications  and Germany’s  SAP  were the latest stocks to join the industry’s increasingly crowded sickbed on Wednesday.  Enterprise software giant SAP was downgraded to Neutral from Buy by UBS analysts.

items.title: Is Soaring AI CapEx Putting Microsoft Stock’s Valuation At Risk?
items.summary: The software franchise converts revenue to cash at a rate few broad-market peers can match, and most of that cash is going straight back into the buildout.

items.title: Intuit Sinks 12% as AI Disruption Fears Spread From TurboTax to QuickBooks, Adobe and ServiceNow Drop 3%
items.summary: Intuit just handed Wall Street something rare: guidance so cautious it sparked fears that AI disruption has moved from theory to measurable damage, pulling Adobe, ServiceNow, and the entire enterprise software sector into the fallout.

items.title: Salesforce vs CrowdStrike: One Stock Has the Clearer Path to Outperformance
items.summary: Salesforce and CrowdStrike both report on the same evening, putting two very different recovery stories side by side. For a retirement portfolio, the signals behind one name line up cleanly while the other flashes a glaring disagreement flag worth understanding before the bell.
